decision: Selected the place coordinates of the Google Maps place 'ODATA DATA CENTER SP01' that ODATA's own SP01 facility page links, as the campus locator of DC SP01 at Estrada dos Romeiros, 943, Votuparim, Santana de Parnaiba.

selected_properties.operator_address: Estrada dos Romeiros, 943 - Votuparim, Santana de Parnaiba - SP

identity_bridge: ODATA Brazil locations page (version 2026-09-25) lists Data Center SP01 at the operator address above.

ODATA's archived DC SP01 facility page (Internet Archive, 16 September 2026) links its 'Acesse o mapa' control to the Google Maps place with feature 0x94cf04b314e9b1e5:0xf3380ea6eefc0470 and !3d-23.4550259 !4d-46.9151172.
The Google Maps place capture of 22 October 2026 echoes the same place coordinates in its payload.

consistency_checks.coordinate_order: Google !3d is latitude and !4d is longitude; stored as GeoJSON [lon, lat]
consistency_checks.datum: not stated (web map; WGS 84 assumed by the map service, not asserted by the operator)
consistency_checks.imagery_check: Esri World Imagery export centred on the point (captured 22 October 2026, local esri-odata-sp01.png, about 800 m square) shows the point on a large flat-roofed building with dense rooftop plant, consistent with a data-centre building, beside the Estrada dos Romeiros; visual plausibility only.
consistency_checks.official_address_point_check: not performed: no Brazilian official address-point service was used
consistency_checks.distance_script: py/geod.py (pyproj 3.7.1 Geod WGS84) in the br-p1 fragment directory
